scenarios.description: RSA/ECDSA test PKI: RSA-4096 root CA, ECDSA P-384 issuing CA with its SEC 1 key, and a chain bundle whose blocks are preceded by subject=/issuer= lines
TLS server: PEM certificate (RSA-2048 key, signed ecdsa-with-SHA384), PKCS#1 key, PKCS#10 CSR and a PKCS#7 full chain
API endpoint: DER certificate (ECDSA P-256 key) and its PKCS#8 key
Certificate revocation list from the issuing CA (one revoked serial)
Legacy self-signed certificate: RSA-1024 key, sha1WithRSAEncryption, DER
Ed25519 device certificate and its PKCS#8 key
RSA-3072 backup key as encrypted PKCS#8 (PBES2) plus its SPKI public key
PKCS#12 client keystore: ECDSA P-256 key, client certificate and issuing CA certificate
JKS truststore: the root CA and a partner root CA that occurs nowhere else
dotenv file: HS256 signing key, a JWT signed with it, the keystore password and the backup-key passphrase
Terraform resource with a database password
OpenSSL configuration: TLS 1.3 only, two cipher suites, a hybrid post-quantum key-exchange group
ML-DSA-65 root CA and an ML-KEM-768 endpoint certificate it signed, with both PKCS#8 keys

properties.name: SHA-256
properties.note: Collision resistance 128 bits; reference point of NIST PQ category 2.

properties.name: SHA-384
properties.note: Hash of ecdsa-with-SHA384 and of the TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384 cipher suite.

properties.name: SHA-512
properties.note: Category >= 4 (SHA-384 collision is the highest hash-based NIST reference point).

properties.name: SHA-1
properties.nistStatus: Disallowed for signature generation (SP 800-131A r2); NIST retires SHA-1 by 2030-12-31

properties.name: SHAKE128
properties.note: Used with a 256-bit output (min(d/2,128) = 128-bit collision resistance).

properties.name: HMAC-SHA256
properties.note: HS256 for the JWT (RFC 7518) and the PKCS#12 integrity MAC (key from the PKCS#12 KDF of RFC 7292 appendix B.2).

properties.name: PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256
properties.nistStatus: Approved (SP 800-132); the iteration counts used here (2,048 and 20,000) are below the OWASP 2023 figure of 600,000
properties.note: PBES2 key derivation (RFC 8018) in the encrypted PKCS#8 key and the PKCS#12 keystore; PRF hmacWithSHA256.

properties.name: AES-256-GCM
properties.note: Record protection of TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384.

properties.name: ChaCha20-Poly1305
properties.note: Stream-cipher AEAD; mode reported as 'other'.

properties.name: AES-256-CBC-PKCS7
properties.nistStatus: Approved mode; unauthenticated (padding-oracle risk without a MAC)
properties.note: PBES2 encryption scheme aes256-CBC-PAD (RFC 8018).

properties.name: RSA-3072 key pair
properties.quantum: Broken by Shor's algorithm on a CRQC
properties.note: Backup key; stored only as encrypted PKCS#8 and as an SPKI public key.

notes.pem-preamble: Free text (subject=/issuer= lines as printed by openssl) precedes each PEM block
notes.der: Binary DER without PEM armour; found only by file extension or content sniffing
notes.pkcs7: PKCS#7 / CMS SignedData with certificates and no signers (.p7b)
notes.pkcs12: Inside a password-protected PKCS#12 file; certificates and key are encrypted (PBES2) and readable only with the password (changeit)
notes.jks: Inside a Java KeyStore; trusted certificate entries are stored in clear, the file is integrity-protected with the store password (changeit)
notes.pkcs1: PKCS#1 RSAPrivateKey: the algorithm is implied by the PEM label; modulus and public exponent are stored with the private key
notes.sec1: SEC 1 ECPrivateKey: the curve OID and the public point are stored with the private scalar
notes.pkcs8: PKCS#8 PrivateKeyInfo with its algorithm identifier
notes.pkcs8-encrypted: Encrypted PKCS#8 (PBES2): the key and its algorithm are inside the ciphertext; the passphrase is in secrets/app.env
notes.pkcs8-seed: PKCS#8 private key in seed form: the public key is not stored and must be derived
notes.openssh: OpenSSH openssh-key-v1 container: key type string, public key and private key
notes.openssh-pub: One-line OpenSSH public key (type, base64 blob, comment)
notes.pqc-oid: Post-quantum algorithm identified only by its OID; libraries without ML-DSA / ML-KEM support reject the object
notes.nested-hash: Hash named only as part of a composite signature algorithm identifier
notes.csr: PKCS#10 certificate request: signed by the key it asks to have certified
notes.crl: X.509 CRL: signed list of revoked serial numbers
notes.jwt: JSON Web Token: the algorithm is named in its base64url-encoded header
notes.env-secret: Secret assigned in a dotenv file
notes.low-entropy-secret: Default or low-entropy value: entropy-based secret scanners do not report it
notes.tf-secret: Secret in a Terraform resource; gitleaks applies its Terraform password rule only to *.tf and *.hcl paths
notes.openssl-cnf: OpenSSL configuration directive in the system default section
notes.suite-name: Algorithms named inside a TLS cipher-suite name
notes.hybrid-group: Hybrid post-quantum TLS key-exchange group (ML-KEM-768 + X25519)
